item.title: Four The Record…
item.description: Read Four The Record… Me: "Good afternoon! What can I get started for ya?" Customer: *Facing away from me.* "Can I get a twenty [quiet] latte [garbled]." Read Four The Record…

item.title: A Manager Full Of Sweet Nothings
item.description: Read A Manager Full Of Sweet Nothings Project Manager: "I brought cake!" Me: "No, thank you, I can't have that much sugar." Project Manager: "Oh, but surely you can have one slice..." Me: "No, I am a diabetic, and I don't want to have blurry vision and be sleepy the rest of the day." Project Manager: "Oh, but your doctor won't know..." Read A Manager Full Of Sweet Nothings

item.title: Making A Musical Exit
item.description: Read Making A Musical Exit I work the closing shift at a store with some bad customers who like to shop needlessly long after closing, and some bad corporate who does not allow us to kick them out. My manager has chosen to develop some clever ways to solve this. Read Making A Musical Exit

item.title: Owned By The Owner(‘s Kids)
item.description: Read Owned By The Owner(‘s Kids) Customer: "You can deliver it to me." Me: "As I said, ma'am, we can't." Customer: "You must be new there. I know the owner personally." Me: "Well, I'm the owner's daughter, and we don't deliver to your area." Read Owned By The Owner(‘s Kids)
